posts.post_subject: Source for Pulsed Holography lasers, parts, info, etc
posts.content_md:
Dear Holographers,

I have now a solid supplier for the SSY-1 SSY1 lasers and all the parts you need for pulsed holography. If you meet certain legal restrictions, I can supply them internationally. I have elicited the services of an International Trade Specialist in getting the proper legal documentation.

See my new page about it at:

[http://www.wdjensen123.com/Holography/SSY1web.htm](http://www.wdjensen123.com/Holography/SSY1web.htm)

I am also going to synthesize my pulsed holography information into a published document. It will be a full how-to based on my research, and will be updated as new information comes in.

Sincerely,

Bill Jensen
